name: fgfd
title: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons
description:
The Field Guide to Floral Dragons blends the world of flowers with the fantastic world of dragons. This book contains everything you need to spark imagination and create floral dragon-filled stories and adventures. Within you'll discover flower-inspired dragon described in depth, their origin stories, biology and habitats, along with details of their relationships with people and other floral dragons.

  • Discover 25+ floral dragons, pests, pollinators and fungal dragons.
  • Play as a floral dragonborn.
  • Learn about the habitats and world.
  • Read evocative research notes that tell a thorny tale.
  • Face off against a fungal threat that endangers all.
